dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate linear 2D narrowing of the dorsal mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region until obscured by water turbidity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The left lateral margin is relatively smooth; the right lateral margin is partially obscured by surface water turbulence and foam, preventing a complete assessment of edge symmetry.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to pale-blue median pixel intensity, indicating a sub-adult or non-mature skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of dark-grey clusters (residual pigmentation) concentrated in the lower posterior dorsal area and along the right-lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey dorsal surface and the darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple distinct dark circular spots on the lower dorsal area and clear, dark parallel linear markings (rake marks) on the left mid-lateral dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible parallel linear rake marks on the left side and several dark circular marks/lesions of varying size across the posterior dorsal surface.
